thread:
Priya (Billing): FYI Zenith Networks (acct ZN-402) disputed invoice 91234 - they were charged twice for March reserved capacity. Invoice shows duplicate line items: Reserved GPU x2 * 3 months. Charging $48,000 instead of $24,000. I attached billing CSV.

billing-bot: Quick-audit: invoice=91234 duplicate_lineitem detected. Likely double-apply during prorate run when subscription change and renewal overlapped. Suggested remediation: issue immediate refund for $24,000 and mark invoice corrected.

Noah (CS): Customer says they saw immediate charge spike and opened a ticket. They want refund and an apology note. Customer is fine with credit to card or account offset.

Rhea (Revenue Ops): We should prefer credit memo to avoid payment gateway refunds unless requested. For accounting, create CM-91234-02 for $24,000 and reverse revenue on next close. Need Legal ack for precedent?

Tom (Legal): Acknowledged. No major risk for credit memo. Recommend including short explanation: "billing system duplicated reserved capacity line during subscription transition". Also note we should not waive late fees if any.

Priya (Billing): Processing credit memo: `/create-credit-memo 91234 24000 "Duplicate reserved capacity - Zenith"` Created CM-91234-02. Posting pending until reconciliation window closes. Notifying customer and offering immediate card refund if they prefer.

Noah (CS): Customer accepted account credit. They asked we confirm the March billing run is fixed.

Rhea (Revenue Ops): Added ticket BO-1519 to fix prorate overlap logic and a regression test. Closing this thread once credit posts. :white_check_mark:
